title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E14 — ShaNaNa, Burl Ives, Slim Gaillard
Santa Claus (Ives) drops by the gas station; Gaillard & Ives do The Night Before Christmas and Rev. Leroy tells ShaNaNa about Scrooge.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E17 — Muhammad Ali, Bobby Darin, Lily Tomlin
The boxing champ makes poetic predictions for his Joe Frazier fight; Tomlin’s a health nut; Flip & Bobby do a vaudeville bit.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E19 — Joe Namath, George Carlin, Abbey Lincoln, Johnny Mathis
Carlin does his Indian Sergeant routine; Abbey dates Freddie Johnson; Flip & Mathis compare dogs and Geraldine works at Namath’s gym.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E20 — Barbara Feldon, Art Carney, Hal Frazier
Cast parodies Mission Impossible; Flip chats with Hal; sketches incl. a gangster at the veterinarian and bowling night.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E8 — Jerry Butler
Singer Jerry Butler headlines this episode, together with his back-up group, Peaches.  Highlights of their numbers are "Make It Easy on Yourself" and "Brand New Me".

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E9 — Morgan/Silver/Humphrey
An all jazz line-up on this edition of Soul! features pianist Horace Silver at the electric keyboard, Lee Morgan on trumpet and 22-year old Bobbi Humphrey playing the flute. They are joined by vocalists Andy and Salome Bey.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E5 — The Election
Webster runs the campaign of a class presidential candidate.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E6 — The Crush
A teenage boy that Katherine gives romantic advice secretly has a crush on her.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E7 — The Chelsea Cat
A friend of George and Katherine's turns out to be a cat burglar.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E8 — Take My Cousin, Please
Aunt Charlotte surprises Papa and Webster by announcing her intention to adopt.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E9 — Heaven
Webster's sorrow over the death of his pet increases when he's told animals don't go to heaven.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E8 — I'll be There
Tia takes a job in a '50s diner to get away from Tamera and is shocked when Tamera starts working there, too.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E9 — Ch-Ch-Changes
The twins are thrilled when Ray and Lisa decide to take their relationship to a more romantic level, but have second thoughts when Roger outlines the downsides of their parents dating.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E10 — Double Exposure
When Tia poses for Tamera's class picture, the gorgeous photo that results makes Tamera extremely popular, and Tia extremely resentful.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E11 — Some Like it Hockey
Determined to make the school's all-male hockey team, Tia and Tamera must disguise themselves as boys and pretend they're just two of the guys!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E12 — Bring on Debate
Ray feels left out by the close bond Tamera forms with her new music teacher.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E2 — Bad Company
After spending the summer traveling with Q’s band, Moesha returns home sporting an engagement ring.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.
